name: osgraph
description: Deterministic, no-LLM dependency graph over a user-defined scope of OutSystems 11 modules open in Service Studio, exposed as an MCP server. REQUIRES osopener (to open the modules it reads) and outsystems-token-manager (to obtain the human-approved session token) to be installed.

osgraphRequires.osopener: Opens the modules in Service Studio that `rebuild` reads; without it rebuild fails MODULES_NOT_OPEN.
osgraphRequires.outsystems-token-manager: Obtains and persists the human-approved Service Studio session token; osgraph only reads token.txt and never calls createSessionToken.
